slug: 2024-01-08 Tunisia Unveils Digital Platform to Boost Education Transparency, Equity

facts.fact: The platform launched by the Ministry of Education on 3 January 2024 at tarbia.tn offers real-time monitoring of each student, with parents able to track attendance, assignments and progress reports and teachers able to manage classes; the article describes what the platform offers at launch and does not say that schools had begun entering these records.
facts.system: L'école de la Tunisie du futur (tarbia.tn)

facts.fact: The article on the 3 January 2024 launch of tarbia.tn gives no number or share of schools using the platform and names no school level.
facts.system: L'école de la Tunisie du futur (tarbia.tn)

facts.fact: The Ministry of Education launched the platform L'école de la Tunisie du futur at tarbia.tn on 3 January 2024, with portals for students, parents and teachers, as stated by We Are Tech Africa citing Minister Mohamed Ali Boughdiri.
facts.system: L'école de la Tunisie du futur (tarbia.tn)
